title: Acceptance probability of a lifted tester
statement: Let $d,n,r$ be nonnegative integers, let $T$ be a nonadaptive tester making $r$ queries to functions from $\mathbb F_2^d$ to the sign set $\{-1,1\}$, let $w\colon\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $p\colon\{1,\ldots,2^d\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Form the tester on inputs consisting of $w$ followed by the truth table of $p$, by translating each query to its truth-table location and translating Boolean answers to signs. Its acceptance probability on that input equals the acceptance probability of $T$ when given the function on $\mathbb F_2^d$ encoded by $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive tester from the $d$-dimensional binary cube to the sign set, with $r$ query positions
$w$ is a Boolean word of length $n$
$p$ is a Boolean truth table of length $2^d$
